$Comment: What the Headless Horseman's daily Claim (Rewards/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily) pays.
Every roll is read on its own: the first three always pay, the last two are chances on top at
Lantern Bombs. His plain armour pays from his second table instead, the one players see as his
Boss Kill Claim (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json), and his flaming armour only from the hard
ride's (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase_Hard.json). The Claim keeps each roll a player
wins with a chance equal to their share of the fight. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. Sweets
and festival tokens pay through the Currency reward kind; a companion mod adds rolls with a file
Name: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily
